buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Materials should be strictly as per the specifications mentioned in the specification document, detailed Technical Specifications attached in the Buyer uploaded ATC document. Offer of the firm deviating from the same shall be summarily rejected. Firms are advised to follow tender specifications and documents mentioned in it. 2. Approved Makes: The list of approved makes of Relays is available on DMRC website https://www.delhimetrorail.com and same will be updated by DMRC on its official website from time to time. The current version of the same may be accessed at https://backend.delhimetrorail.com/documents/11389/List-Empanelled-Makes-of-Major-Electrical-Items-31. 07.2026.pdf . At the time of submitting the vendor proposal, the updated list as available on DMRC website shall be applicable. 3. The firm has to mention the Make & Model of the offered products clearly in their offer and submit compliance of the detailed technical specifications attached as Annexure-A in the Buyer uploaded ATC document and also submit brochure of the offered product. Make/Brand of the offered product must be as per Clause 2 of Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. Any other Make/Brand offered by the bidder shall be summarily rejected. 4. If an authorized channel partner is submitting the offer on behalf of OEM, a Bid Specific OEM Authorization Certificate is mandatorily required, failing which the offer shall be summarily rejected. 5. Warranty Terms: 24 months from the date of technical suitability of product after delivery. The Bidder has to provide the Warranty Certificate from OEM of the offered product along with the supply. 6. The bidder shall participate either as OEM or Authorised Channel partner of the OEM and not both, failing which offer is liable to be ignored and rejected. 7. PERFORMANCE CRITERIA:

Firm shall submit at-least 01 year performance certificate of offered relay model or corresponding series/versions of offered model issued from any govt. organization at the time of submission of technical bid. 8. LOCAL CONTENT CRITERIA: Bidders are required to submit a document certified by OEM of the offered product, declaring the percentage of local content and location(s) of value addition in the offered product. Proforma for the Statement of the Local Content Details of the locations at Activity/Component/Stage/ % Local S.N. which the local value Service Content addition is made 9. Forms of EMD: EMD only through RTGS / NEFT / Internet banking shall be accepted. The bank details of DMRC for the purpose of EMD submission is as follows: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited Account No.: 35281970524 IFSC Code: SBIN0000691 Bank Name: State Bank of India Branch address: 11, Sansad Marg, New Delhi-110001 Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of online transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 10. Requirement of Performance Security: a) Performance Security is to be furnished within 30 days of the award of contract. If the Contractor, having been called upon by Purchaser to furnish Performance Guarantee fails to submit the same within 30 days and there is a delay in submission of Performance Security on his part then the same can be condoned by the Tender Accepting Authority but subject to charging of a penal interest at the rate of 0.5% per week of Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) amount for delayed period. In normal course if PBG is not submitted within 60 days of LOA the contract should be cancelled and other penal actions may be taken against the contract. b) If the Contractor, having been called upon by the Purchaser to furnish Performance Guarantee fails or delay to furnish the same, it shall be lawful for the Purchaser: - i) to cancel contract or any part thereof and to purchase or authorize purchase of the stores at the risk and cost of supplier ii) Get delay in submission of performance security condoned by the Tender Accepting Authority but subject to charging of a penal interest at the rate of 0.5% per week of Performance Bank Guarantee amount for delayed period. c) In case of JV/Consortium, PBG shall be in the name of JV/ Consortium and not individual member(s). There may be more than one BGs but all must be in the name of JV/ Consortium d) The performance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring entity’s account in the event of a breach of contract by the contractor.

e) The PBG format is uploaded in the Buyer uploaded Bid Specific ATC, successful bidder will be required to refer the same for PBG submission. f) PBG shall remain valid for a period of 6 (six) months beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations of the supplier including warranty period. 11. Forms of Performance Bank Guarantee: Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt or Performance Bank Guarantee. · FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of “Delhi Metro Rail Corporation Limited” A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 30 days of award of contract. If Performance Security is submitted in the form of Performance Bank Guarantee, it should be in the format as per Annexure-X attached in Buyer uploaded Bid ATC document. 12. Deviations: a) All deviations, comments and exceptions shall be furnished exclusively in Annexure-Y (Statement of Deviations). b) Any deviation, qualification or condition mentioned elsewhere in the bid shall be treated as null and void and deemed to have been withdrawn. c) If Annexure-Y is not submitted, the bid shall be evaluated on the basis of Nil Deviations. d) Deviations affecting the tender conditions, specifications or scope of supply may render the offer liable for rejection. 13. Payment Terms: 100% payment after receipt, inspection and acceptance of the material. 14. GST Details: i. For supplies to DMRC depots located in Delhi, invoices (Bill-to and Ship-to) shall bear GSTIN: 07AAACD3254A2ZA ii. For supplies to Ajronda, Gurgaon or Bahadurgarh Depots (Haryana), invoices (Bill-to and Ship-to) shall bear GSTIN: 06AAACD3254A1ZD 15. Relaxation in Eligibility Criteria norms for offers from Micro and Small Enterprises: In case of offers from Micro and Small Enterprises (Manufacturer of the offered products), the value/financial limits applicable for Eligibility criteria for Average Annual Turnover for bulk ordering shall be 75% of the corresponding values for these criteria i.e. ₹ 28 Lakh (subject to their offer meeting of quality and technical specifications). 16. TEST CERTIFICATES: Firm shall submit latest type test report of relays as per latest relevant IEC standards, in line with Clause 10 of the Specification Document (Annexure-A) attached in the Buyer uploaded ATC document. 17. All other terms and conditions shall be as specified in the “Specification Document” attached in
the Buyer uploaded ATC document. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
